projects.title: Go Truenas
bullets: Built a Go client for the TrueNAS Scale websocket API across 66 files, with continuous integration and an automated test suite.
Documented setup steps in detail after realizing the official API had little public reference material to build against.

projects.title: Unusedfunc
bullets: Wrote a Go linter that identifies unused functions across a project, structured across 227 files with CI and automated tests.

projects.title: Rumpus
bullets: Designed Rumpus, a terminal color scheme across 29 files, packaged with continuous integration for consistent releases.

leadership.title: Documentation Contributor
bullets: Writes setup guides for small self-hosted tools after watching newcomers abandon projects that had code but no onboarding notes.
Learned that a well-scoped README changes how many people actually try a tool, and began prioritizing it before new features.
